title: Roon
description: Roon Core health. Most data comes from the Roon logs, because Roon has no metrics.

panels.title: Core starts
panels.description: Starts of the Roon core in the last 24 hours, from its output. The core can restart in the container, so this can be higher than the container restart count.

panels.title: Stream issues
panels.description: Tracks stopped by an error, lost endpoints, slow media and poor connections in the last 24 hours.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service="roonserver",logstream="file"} |~ "Track Stopped Due to|StoppedLostEndpoint|media_slow|poor connection|too much time locked" [24h]))

panels.title: Endpoint drops
panels.description: RAAT disconnects in the last 24 hours. An endpoint that sleeps or restarts also counts.

panels.title: Critical errors
panels.description: Critical lines in the Roon log in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Core CPU
panels.description: 100% is one full core.

panels.title: Stream problems
panels.description: Each bar counts log lines. Compare the time with the Host row below.

targets.expr: sum by (zone, reason) (count_over_time({service="roonserver",logstream="file"} |~ "Track Stopped Due to" | regexp "\\[zone (?P<zone>[^\\]]+)\\] Track Stopped Due to (?P<reason>\\w+)" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Endpoint drops
panels.description: If one endpoint drops often, check that device or its network. If all drop together, check the core.

panels.title: Drops
panels.description: RAAT connections lost in the last 24 hours. A device that sleeps or restarts also counts.

panels.title: Reconnects
panels.description: RAAT connections made in the last 24 hours. Many reconnects mean that a device is unstable.

panels.title: Write errors
panels.description: Roon could not send to a device in the last 24 hours. This can interrupt audio.

panels.title: Unavailable reports
panels.description: Times that Roon reported an endpoint in a zone as unavailable in the last 24 hours. A device that is off also counts.

panels.title: Drops by device
panels.description: If one device drops often, check that device or its Wi-Fi. If all drop at the same time, check the Roon core or the network.

targets.expr: sum by (device, ip) (count_over_time({service="roonserver",logstream="file"} |= "=> Disconnected" |= "Bluesound" | regexp "\\[raat\\] \\[(?P<device>Bluesound [^\\]@]+?) @ (?P<ip>[0-9.]+):[0-9]+\\] => Disconnected" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Write errors by device
panels.description: Roon could not send to the device. This can interrupt audio.

targets.expr: sum by (device, ip) (count_over_time({service="roonserver",logstream="file"} |= "error writing to connection" |= "Bluesound" | regexp "\\[raat_ll/client\\] \\[(?P<device>Bluesound [^\\]@]+?) @ (?P<ip>[0-9.]+):[0-9]+\\] error writing to connection" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Reconnects by device
panels.description: Each bar is a new RAAT connection to the device.

targets.expr: sum by (device, ip) (count_over_time({service="roonserver",logstream="file"} |= "=> Connected" |= "Bluesound" | regexp "\\[raat\\] \\[(?P<device>Bluesound [^\\]@]+?) @ (?P<ip>[0-9.]+):[0-9]+\\] => Connected" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Availability reports
panels.description: How Roon reported each endpoint when it loaded a zone. Two devices of the same model share a name here.

targets.expr: sum by (device, available) (count_over_time({service="roonserver",logstream="file"} |= "with endpoint Bluesound" | regexp "with endpoint (?P<device>Bluesound .+?) \\([^)]*\\) \\[IsAvailable=(?P<available>[A-Za-z]+)\\]" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Clock sync delay by device
panels.description: The longest delay when Roon syncs its clock with a speaker. Roon logs this only when the delay is long. High values on one speaker suggest a Wi-Fi problem on that speaker, and can cause dropouts in grouped playback.

targets.expr: max by (device) (max_over_time({service="roonserver",logstream="file"} |= "long rtt sync" | regexp "long rtt sync (?P<device>[^:]+): realtime=[0-9]+ rtt=(?P<rtt>[0-9]+)us" | unwrap rtt [$__auto]))

panels.title: Slow clock syncs by device
panels.description: How often Roon logged a long clock sync for each speaker.

targets.expr: sum by (device) (count_over_time({service="roonserver",logstream="file"} |= "long rtt sync" | regexp "long rtt sync (?P<device>[^:]+): realtime" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Pressure: time spent waiting
panels.description: The share of time that at least one task waited. A rise at the time of a problem points to host load.

panels.title: Disk busy (top 8)
panels.description: nvme0n1 is the Fast pool. The sd disks are Vault.

panels.title: Top CPU containers
panels.description: 1.0 is one full core. Shows what else used the host at that time.

panels.title: TCP retransmits and NIC errors
panels.description: A rise suggests a network problem, not a disk or CPU problem.

panels.title: Core memory, from Roon
panels.description: From the [stats] lines of Roon. Steady growth over days suggests a memory leak.

panels.title: GC pauses
panels.description: High values mean that the core stops often for memory cleanup.

targets.expr: avg(avg_over_time({service="roonserver",logstream="file"} |= "[stats]" | regexp "(?P<v>[0-9.]+)% of runtime in GC pauses" | unwrap v [$__auto]))

panels.title: Core CPU
panels.description: 1.0 is one full core.

panels.title: Core disk
panels.description: cAdvisor can under-report disk IO on ZFS.

targets.expr: {service="roonserver",logstream="file"} |~ "Track Stopped Due to|StoppedLostEndpoint|media_slow|poor connection|too much time locked|socketerr|error writing to connection"

panels.title: Warnings and errors
panels.description: Hides login messages for services that are not in use, and the Roon ARC port test.

panels.title: Core output
panels.description: Starts and crashes appear here. Hides the sound card messages, which are normal in a container.
